title: selectinload adjustment for extra_criteria needs to accommodate nesting

labels.name: loader options
labels.description: ORM options like joinedload(), load_only(), these are complicated and have a lot of issues

body:
this is from #6880.  i thought this was joinedload caching but it appears to be the lambda for selectinload holding onto the paramters.   we should also get a more succinct test case

```py
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, ForeignKey, create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import (
    declarative_base,
    relationship,
    backref,
    selectinload,
    joinedload,
    aliased,
    Session,
)


engine = create_engine("sqlite:///test.sqlite", echo=True, query_cache_size=0)
Base = declarative_base()


class Part(Base):
    __tablename__ = "parts"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String)
    color = Column(String)

    parent_id = Column(
        Integer, ForeignKey("parts.id")
    )
    children = relationship(
        "Part",
        backref=backref("parent", remote_side=[id]),
        foreign_keys=[parent_id],

        # set this to work around
        # bake_queries=False
    )



Base.metadata.drop_all(engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(engine)


def create_db():
    with Session(engine) as sess:

        part1 = Part()
        part1.name = "car"
        part1.color = "red"
        sess.add(part1)

        part2 = Part()
        part2.name = "wheel"
        part2.color = "black"
        part2.parent = part1
        sess.add(part2)

        part3 = Part()
        part3.name = "interior"
        part3.color = "velvet"
        part3.parent = part1
        sess.add(part3)

        part4 = Part()
        part4.name = "dashboard"
        part4.color = "gold"
        part4.parent = part3
        sess.add(part4)

        part5 = Part()
        part5.name = "door_handle"
        part5.color = "platinum"
        part5.parent = part3
        sess.add(part5)

        part6 = Part()
        part6.name = "scooter"
        part6.color = "purple"
        sess.add(part6)
        sess.commit()


def exec_selectinload(sess, name, part_colors):
    level1 = aliased(Part, name="level1")
    level2 = aliased(Part, name="level2")

    query = (
        sess.query(Part)
        .filter(Part.name == name)
        .options(
            selectinload(
                Part.children.of_type(level1).and_(
                    level1.color.in_(part_colors)
                )
            ).options(
                joinedload(
                    level1.children.of_type(level2).and_(
                        (level1.color + "." + level2.color).in_(part_colors)
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    )
    return query.first()



create_db()

fn = exec_selectinload

with Session(engine) as sess:
    result = fn(sess, "car", ["velvet", "velvet.gold"])
    assert result.name == "car"
    assert result.children[0].name == "interior"
    assert result.children[0].children[0].name == "dashboard"

# second try
with Session(engine) as sess:
    result = fn(sess, "car", ["blue", "purple", "velvet"])
    assert result.name == "car"
    assert result.children[0].name == "interior"
    assert len(result.children[0].children) == 0
```
